{{Quote|Here we stand, at the extremity of our exertion, having cast behind us the idols of our fathers, to once again carry to our foe the penalties due their sacrilege. Come perdition or hard vacuum, the Republic expects that every citizen will do his duty.|Supreme Chancellor Contispex, ''Fourth Inaugural Oration''|<ref name="TTSP">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>}}
The '''Pius Dea Era''' was an era of time in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from [[11,987 BBY]] to [[10,966 BBY]]. During this time, the [[Contispex dynasty]] of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellors]] initiated the [[Pius Dea Crusades]] against outlying alien cultures, reversing a previous trend of cultural integration. Those under persecution fled to [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], transforming the [[Rimward Slice]] into a staging grounds for soldiers, as well as an area for war profiteers to operate. Also during this time, [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depots]] proliferated and were a constant reminder to those outside the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Timeline of the Pius Dea Era==
*[[11,987 BBY]]
**[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Pers'lya]] is impeached by the [[Pius Dea]] sect and replaced by Pius Dea favorite [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[11,965 BBY]]
**The [[First Pius Dea Crusade]]. Contispex I sanctions a military invasion of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], beginning the Pius Dea Crusades.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[11,947 BBY]]
**Contispex I steps down as Supreme Chancellor and is succeeded by his son [[Contispex II]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[11,939 BBY]]
**The [[Third Pius Dea Crusade]]. Contispex II sanctions yet another invasion of Hutt Space, instigating the Third crusade.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[11,933 BBY]]
**The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] begins its [[Recusal]], retreating to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and severing all ties with the Republic.<ref name="TEGtW" /> The Jedi still loyal to the [[Pius Dea]] cult form the [[Order of the Terrible Glare/Legends|Order of the Terrible Glare]] and settle on [[Garn/Legends|Garn]].
*[[11,920 BBY]]
**The [[Fourth Pius Dea Crusade]] begins against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[11,884 BBY]]
**The Seventh Pius Dea Crusade, also known as the [[Great Northern Crusade]], begins against the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] and other [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the northern region of the galaxy.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*c. [[11,820 BBY]]
**The [[Sixth Alsakan Conflict]] begins as the [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakani]] ally with the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]], and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] against the Pius Dea-controlled Republic.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[11,791 BBY]]
**The Tenth Pius Dea Crusade, also known as the [[Crusade of the Wilds]], begins.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[11,708 BBY]]
**According to traditional Tapani historians, this is the date when the [[Tapani sector#Twelve Kingdoms Era (11,708–7,342 BBY)|Twelve Kingdoms Era]] began.
*[[11,707 BBY]]
**The [[Eleventh Pius Dea Crusade]] against the Herglics begins.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[11,660 BBY]]
**The [[Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade]]. Republic forces orbitally bombard [[Zarracina III]], turning its surface into an irradiated wasteland and forcing the native Zarracines into a nomadic existence.
*[[11,600s BBY]]
**Republic settlers fleeing the oppressive rule of the Pius Dea discover and settle the [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|fourth planet]] of the [[Prefsbelt system/Legends|Prefsbelt system]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[11,591 BBY]]
**The [[Fifteenth Pius Dea Crusade]] against the [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] begins.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[11,500s BBY]]
**Development of [[Cathedral ship]]s.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[11,198 BBY]]
**The [[Twenty-Third Pius Dea Crusade]] against the Bothans and the [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lanniks]] begins.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*c. [[11,100 BBY]]
**The [[Inquisition]]s begin in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
**The Jedi Order's Recusal ends, and they inspire the heretical [[Renunciates|Renunciate]] movement within the Pius Dea.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[11,057 BBY]]
**The [[Thirty-Fourth Pius Dea Crusade]] against the Hutts begins.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[11,000 BBY]]
**Development of the [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumpers]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
*[[10,970s BBY]]
**[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Pers Pradeux]] of the Renunciates&mdash;still operating in secrecy&mdash;discover Prefsbelt and set up the Renunciates' main naval base on the planet.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[10,967 BBY]]
**The [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict]]&mdash;also called the Renunciation&mdash;occurs.<ref name="TEGtW" />
***The Renunciates reveal themselves and ally with Alsakani, [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]], and the Jedi Order, splitting the Pius Dea faith from within.<ref name="TEGtW" />
***Renunciate forces clash with [[Pius Dea|Faithful]] at [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], [[Ixtlar/Legends|Ixtlar]], and [[Cyrillia/Legends|Cyrillia]], supported by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Alsakani, Duros, Herglics, and Hutts.<ref name="TEGtW" />
*[[10,966 BBY]]
**The [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] seed the Republic Navy with rogue navicomputer codes, which forces the Pius Dea's ships to jump randomly to hyperspace and become lost forever.<ref name="TEGtW" />
**At the [[Battle of Uquine]], the Renunciate forces annihilate the remaining Pius Dea ships. The Jedi capture [[Contispex XIX]] aboard the ''[[Flame of Sinthara]]'', taking him to [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]] where he stands trial and is imprisoned.<ref name="TEGtW" />
**[[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Biel Ductavis]] assumes the position of Supreme Chancellor.<ref name="TEGtW" />
